base.policy: Member1 is an experimental lower-cost base, not adopted. All arms run the same actual2-network graph, shared PIL RGB256/ImageNet, FP32 softmax/native bilinear align_cornersFalse/fiber priority. Classwise historical quality reference remains separately reported; no cross-run timing subtraction.

observation.policy: Identical current-frame fitter/settings for all geometry arms, fed current member1 native probability and raw class2 mask. No history-assisted seed/ROI, no candidate refit/rerank, no color gate, no GT. Current observation itself is not ground truth; fitter component/entry biases remain limitations.

state.tip: entry + length*[cos(angle),sin(angle)]; derived image endpoint, not physical tip ground truth
state.taper: Lc=length-cap_axis_ratio*distal_width/2; if Lc>0, signed half-taper=atan2(proximal_width-distal_width,2*Lc). Side-line directions derived from same state; never smooth redundant endpoint/angle quantities independently.
state.uncertainty: Track age/missing/rejected count, innovation and evidence flags only. No calibrated covariance/confidence interval or probability of correctness.

innovation_limits.scale: D=hypot(H,W); compare current observation to predicted state. Limits reused exactly from legacy tracker for first control. They are engineering hypotheses, not learned physical bounds or device calibration; no post-result tuning.

gated_update_policy.normal: If finite positive geometry and innovation passes every limit, same alpha-beta update as legacy; clear pending branch and prediction-only age.
gated_update_policy.isolated_jump: Reject from active-state update, save current valid observation in pending branch, predict active state and increase prediction-only age. Do not accept merely because neural probability is high. No visible mask deletion or fill.
gated_update_policy.pending_confirmation: Three consecutive valid observations must be pairwise consistent under the same frozen limits, using actual inter-observation dt and pending constant-velocity extrapolation after two samples. Broken sequence restarts pending count. A normal observation matching active state clears pending. At third consistent pending sample, initialize active state at current sample, zero velocity, status confirmed_relocation; never rewrite earlier states.
gated_update_policy.missing: No fit clears consecutive pending confirmation; active state may predict at most3 consecutive missing/rejected frames; fourth clears active state. Confirmation is evaluated before active-state expiry. A current valid pending count continues across active expiry, but a current accepted in-gate measurement clears it. No measurement means no visible geometry evidence.
gated_update_policy.initialization: With no active/pending state, first valid fit initializes immediately for parity with legacy; this cannot authenticate a wrong first observation. With pending state, do not bypass confirmation via uninitialized shortcut.
gated_update_policy.reset: Explicit sequence/source change, image shape change, nonmonotonic timestamp or gap>0.5s clears active/pending state. Do not invent an unvalidated scene-cut detector in this control. Large real movement without a cut can take three observations to relocate; log the two-frame confirmation delay.
gated_update_policy.invalid_state: No finite/positive length,width,cap or Lc<=0 => unavailable geometry; never rasterize or repair into a visible mask. Record validation failures for every arm.

mask_policy.all_arms: Output EXACTLY the current raw member1 fused mask. Neither visible_fiber(), rasterize(), ideal-template intersection, component deletion, geometry-driven additions nor crop refinement is called. Geometry output is separate metadata/overlay.
mask_policy.stone: Exact raw stone class set preserved; existing coarse stone/fiber errors remain. No claim that state tracking solves the85/523 protected-pixel conflict.
mask_policy.static_images: Fresh empty state per image; no sequence of image-dev rows, no state transfer between132 images. Static diagnostic fit is allowed, temporal predictions are not.

execution.warmup_state_policy: Warm network/fitter allocations using scratch state; clear active and pending state before real frame0.
execution.time: Use monotonic decoded PTS only when reliable; otherwise declared frame_index/sourceFPS for whole stream. Never use wall-clock execution speed as video dt or mix timestamp bases silently.
execution.static: Fresh native model1 reproduction on202 references; all state-only masks must match it exactly. Fit/initialization on individual images only. Never treat the70 sparse video references as consecutive frames: their temporal geometry comes from their true indices in full replay. Per-arm masks do not require repeated identical static forward copies; log inherited masks explicitly.
execution.performance: Measure actual2net preprocess/forward/native mapping+both3class expert maps and mask CPU transfer, FOV+fit, state update, total pipeline, full decode/render/audit/export cycle; p50,p95,max, allocated GPU peak, CPU runtime, actual network/model hashes. No sums/subtractions of percentiles.
execution.outputs: Per-frame raw RGB/mask hashes, fit acceptance/reason, observed/predicted geometry, derived tip/side angles, residuals, pending count, prediction age, reset/rejection/confirmation reasons, timings. Full native masks or immutable raw references with per-frame hash verification; complete comparison video for each source, all statuses/failures retained.

evaluation.segmentation: 70video/132image stone,fiber Dice/P/R/boundary F and paired TP/FP/FN changes must reproduce model1 exactly; report29/new41/43-27 cases/68-64 sources/25-107 exposure, and separate frozen classwise figures. Zero change is an invariant, not improvement.
evaluation.geometry: Validity, prediction-only coverage, rejection/confirmation/reset rates, missing-run length, parameter velocity/acceleration and derived-tip motion are diagnostics. Reduced jitter or fit residual does NOT prove geometric accuracy. No tip error/angle accuracy without independent references.
evaluation.real_motion: Report camera/fiber fast movement, frame gaps, wrong initialization, delayed relocation and occlusion separately. No optical-flow compensation in first control; unregistered adjacent-mask IoU/change is not segmentation accuracy or guaranteed temporal quality.
evaluation.synthetic_tests: Deterministic analytical trajectories test isolated outlier rejection, persistent3-observation relocation at current frame only, angle wrap, dt scaling, missing expiry/pending interaction, source/shape/time reset, prefix causality, static-order independence and raw-mask no mutation. Synthetic fixtures never fit device parameters or establish clinical accuracy.
evaluation.gates: All invariants/tests/identity checks pass, masks unchanged on every replay/static frame, no future/state leakage or hidden mask fill, all8 full processes complete. For a production candidate require same-run pipeline p95<=each source interval. Failed cost still fully replayed and reported. No adoption or downstream pixel fusion solely from these diagnostic gates.

stop: Finite4-arm T0 only. Do not tune legacy gates, confirmation count or TTL on videos, add candidates, trigger history-seeded search, enable pixel correction, train, adopt model1/default, or start stone memory automatically. If T0 mechanism is sound, separately freeze T1 search candidate/evidence/budget/ablation protocol; without geometric references its accuracy claims remain limited.
constraints: Videos and derivatives validation only, stone_new excluded from all training, original521/132/144/29 split and active70 references frozen. A0 inference only, never new training initialization. No144 reserved-test pixels or training pixels read in T0. Unknown255 excluded. Histories independent per video and absent for static images; no Godot-to-real calibration assumption. All models/sources/config/input/output identities recorded. Any training requires separately approved plan.
